name: campaign_id
description: Campaign identifier, e.g. CMP-003. Joins to ad_performance and creative_variants.

name: name
description: Campaign name, e.g. Winter Sun Early Bird 2025.

name: objective
description: The business outcome the campaign was meant to produce.

name: target_segment
description: Audience key, e.g. lapsed_compass (lapsed Compass members), lapsed_compass_cold, all_customers, active_compass, urban_explorers.

name: end_date
description: Last flight date. 2026-12-31 for always-on programs.

name: channels
description: Channels used: one of paid_search, paid_social, organic, email, direct, affiliate.

name: budget_usd
description: Approved budget in US dollars for the flight (annual budget for always-on programs).

name: spend_to_date_usd
description: Paid media actually spent through Sep 15, 2026, from ad_performance.

name: bookings_attributed
description: Confirmed bookings attributed to the campaign (to date for campaigns still running).

name: roi
description: Contribution ROI as reported in the retrospective: (attributed revenue × 22% contribution margin − campaign cost) ÷ campaign cost. Negative means the campaign lost money.

name: retrospective
description: Two to three sentences on what happened and what was learned.
